protocol.name: fresh_local_refinement_confirmation
protocol.scope: New locally trained refinements fitted only to the listed training matches and selected only on listed validation match.
protocol.test_policy: Freeze configuration and model before one final J03WQQ evaluation. No test-target inspection, target-derived preprocessing, or test-driven parameter selection.
protocol.pathcrf_caveat: J03WQQ was validation for the published PathCRF trial140 checkpoint; it is NOT an independent held-out test for that checkpoint or adaptations selected with that checkpoint validation.
protocol.previous_matches_caveat: J03WPY and J03WR9 have already been viewed/evaluated and must not support fresh held-out claims after refinement.
protocol.selection_policy: Use J03WOY only. Target per-frame macro-F1 >=0.90, then maximize official spell F1 among eligible configurations; otherwise select highest validation macro-F1.
protocol.split_policy: Whole matches, no random frame split. Existing primary split remains unchanged.
protocol.dead_ball_artifact_caveat: Sportec freezes ball XY during dead periods upstream; separately disclose any detector using this cue and do not infer broadcast generalization.
